intent: Technical Brief: ASUS ROG Strix G16 Reboot Loop
detected_fault: Repeated reboot loop every 60 seconds after repasting, characterized by fans spinning, RGB lights turning on, black screen with no BIOS or ASUS logo, and automatic shutdown and subsequent restart.
suggested_solution: Inspect the laptop's cooling system and TIM for any signs of damage or leakage
Reapply a new layer of liquid metal with proper application techniques
Verify that all thermal paste is evenly distributed and not dried out
Check the power delivery system to ensure it is functioning correctly
Consider replacing the laptop's cooling system if the issue persists
